slices.behaviour: The floor, the kill check and CI read a plan entry the one way paths reads it: mutation.source_files normalises each entry through paths.normalise, so ./packages/core/src/fee.ts stands for packages/core/src/fee.ts and a trailing slash is dropped, and a parent of packages/core/src (packages, packages/core) stands for all of src, so the tdd gate refuses a slice naming packages/core with no measurement (F1 of the attempt 9 review); the second reader mutation.covers is deleted and mutation.py and gates.py call paths.covers, so a kill in fee.ts counts for a slice naming ./packages/core/src/fee.ts (F2); and a change to the root tsconfig.base.json makes mutation_ci.select choose all of src (F3).
slices.failure_reason: test_a_parent_directory_of_src_stands_for_all_of_src: AssertionError: Lists differ: [] != ['packages/core/src']; test_a_dot_slash_prefixed_entry_is_read_as_the_guard_reads_it: AssertionError: Lists differ: [] != ['packages/core/src/fee.ts']; test_a_slice_naming_a_parent_of_src_with_no_measurement_is_refused: AssertionError: HarnessError not raised; test_a_kill_in_a_file_a_slice_names_with_a_dot_slash_prefix_is_a_red: HarnessError: Check 3 exited 0 and is cited as a RED because its Stryker report killed a mutant, but every mutant it killed is in a file the slice does not name: killed in packages/core/src/fee.ts, the slice names ./packages/core/src/fee.ts; test_only_paths_defines_a_function_named_covers: AssertionError: Lists differ: ['mutation.py:126'] != []; test_a_changed_root_tsconfig_selects_all_of_src: AssertionError: None != 'src/**/*.ts,!src/**/*.test.ts'
